fields.name: Text_Add_Customer_Machine
fields.fieldText:
➕ Add Customer Machine

Use this screen to add a machine that is not yet available in the customer’s machine list.


🏷️ Machine Information

Enter the machine model and, if known, the serial number.


📍 Installation Location

Specify where the machine is installed at the customer site, for example “1st Floor – Kitchen” or “Bar Area”.


✅ Once the machine has been created, it can be selected and included in the current Quality Check.

fields.name: Text_Customer_Machine_Info
fields.fieldText:
🔧 Machine Information

Review the machine information before continuing with the beverage assessment.


✏️ You can update machine details where required. Some fields, such as the Machine Name / Model, can only be edited if the machine does not originate from Darboven contract data.


ℹ️ Information provided through Darboven contract data is read-only and cannot be changed within the Quality Check.

fields.name: Text_Capture_Beverage_Results
fields.fieldText:
☕ Capture Beverage Results

🥤 Select Beverage & Product

Select the beverage and product that should be tested for the selected machine.


⭐ Evaluate the Beverage

For each beverage, enter a taste rating, a visual rating, and any relevant comments or recommendations.


➕ Add Additional Beverages

Use Add to capture additional beverages for the same machine.

fields.name: Text_Machine_Check_Summary
fields.fieldText:
🛠️ Machine Check Summary

✅ Recommended Actions

Select or define the recommended follow-up actions resulting from the machine check.


📈 Actions to Improve Quality

Document any actions that should be taken to improve the beverage or machine quality.


🖼️ Product Presentation

Evaluate how the products are presented at the machine.


🍵 Tea Presentation

Indicate whether EILLES Tea is visibly presented at the machine. If not, specify which competitor is currently displayed or promoted.


💬 Additional Comments

Add any further observations, notes, or recommendations related to the machine check.


ℹ️ Please complete the relevant information before finishing the machine check.

fields.name: Text_Select_Machine
fields.fieldText:
🔧 Select Machine

Select the machine that should be included in the Quality Check.


🔎 If the required machine is not available in the selection, choose None and click Next.


➕ You will then be able to add a new machine to the customer’s machine list and include it in the current Quality Check.

fields.name: Text_Select_Contact
fields.fieldText:
👤 Select or create a contact


Select the contact associated with this Quality Check from the list below.


➕ If the contact is not available in the list, select None and click Next to create a new contact.


✅ Once you have selected the correct contact, click Next to continue.
